summary: Merck & Co., Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the closing of an underwritten public offering of $6 billion aggregate principal amount of notes across seven tranches, including floating rate notes due 2028 and fixed-rate notes maturing from 2028 to 2056 with coupons ranging from 4.300% to 5.850%. The offering was conducted under an existing shelf registration statement (S-3ASR) and indenture with U.S. Bank Trust National Association. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. No special-situation elements such as acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring are present.
